preconditions.description: The number of stones n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i in stones)
preconditions.description: Each dimension of each stone is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of stones chosen k is either 1 or 2.
The number of chosen stones matches k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= stone_number <= n for stone_number in chosen_stones)
postconditions.description: Each chosen stone number is between 1 and n inclusive.
The chosen stone numbers are distinct.

postconditions.expression: max_radius == max(min(a, b, c) for a, b, c in possible_parallelepipeds) / 2
postconditions.description: The maximum possible radius of the inscribed sphere is correctly calculated.
